body:
MDPV Amazing
I have purchased pure MDPV multiple times and can say it is not my favorite drug but the price and high is great.  Everyone seems to hate on MDPV. I have gone through grams I came down.  I have vaporized insufflated and orally.  I would have to say vaporizing MDPV is my favorite it makes me a fiend while I am high on it. I stayed awake for 5 days straight I had soars in my mouth.  I have noticed Insufflation causes the worst side effects.
Putting MDPV on weed and smoking it out of a bubbler is the best way to do I always used multiple screens the MDPV would melt right through the weed and screens.  Taken orally feels like adderall from my personal experiences.  I have only done coke once and it doesnt compare maybe it was shitty coke but the MDPV I have bought has always been pure.
I have done doses from anywhere 2mgs to 50mgs at once. 2mg-5mgs is the vaporizing dose with repeated dose every 15mins until I get to were I want to be and I always know when I'm good. I'll be good for a few hours until redosing again if I want to.  I'm not real experienced with insufflation I do not do it that much but from the few times I have done it I would say I usually would do more than 5 mg and it was just so many negative side effects I will never snort it again.
I have not had miserable comedowns I usually make sure I sleep right after I comedown so my mind doesnt go crazy.  When I was on the 5 day binge the worst side effects I had was probably audio hallucinations.  I came down from the 5 day binge perfectly fine no horrible come down.  Worst I had was soars in my mouth.
Currently I'm on an oral dose I took right before I started writing this probable dose around 30mgs-50mgs. I do not have my scale but comparing the dose to what I have put on my MG scale this is no more than 50mgs. I have mixed with am2201 and recommend never mixing this drug with any synthetic cannabanoid.  I probably did about 20mgs of am2201 and 20mgs of MDPV .1grams of weed .1grams of k2. I instantly passed out had sleep apnea and my close friend said my heart stopped at one point.
Weed MDPV benzos thats the best combination but I have to be careful. Benzos make me think I'm not that high and will continue to redose.  Despite all the negative media attention I love this stimulant.  I apologize for the poor grammer but I'm typing this fast on vacation I just would like everyone to know there's one positive experience with this drug.
My sleep was never horribly affected with this drug I think Adderall is much worse when affecting sleep.  The secret is moderation just like any drug.
[Reported Dose: 'Repeated use over months']
